title: Kagamine Rin — Sending My Singing Voice〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

meta.Event: On This Blank Canvas, I Paint

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I feel like trying a little bit more now...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Okay, we'll be heading back now.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yes, it's nice to see that everything went smoothly.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Do you think Ena will be okay, Rin?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
I don't know.
It's only going to get tougher from here.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: But she said she'd keep trying...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Okay. That means all we can do is sit back and watch.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: As well as your little chat went, you don't seem all that happy about it.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Ena said she wants to keep studying art so that she can properly illustrate the images in her head.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: But she has to work so hard in order to reach that level...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Does that mean she has to keep suffering like this?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Remember how she drew me that one time? I really liked what she made...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
She's such a good artist...
But that's not good enough?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I see what you mean. Her drawing of you was very good. Kanade and the others said so themselves...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: But Ena wants to reach the next level somehow.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh, a real comment. What a nice change of pace, MEIKO.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: But she's right. Ena isn't satisfied with her status quo. She wishes to move forward despite how hard it's going to be.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
You understand that, don't you, Rin?
Isn't that why you went to see her that time?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: But is it really necessary for her to go through that? Even when she knows in advance that she's going to suffer...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: That's how she feels. That's what she truly wants, so all we can do is watch over her.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. And it's very like her to make such a choice.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: You just want her to smile, don't you...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
I'm not sure what we can do for her...
But I know that we should place our faith in her.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yes. It was fun seeing you worry so much about someone for a change, Rin.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I'm not sure I needed to thank Luka just now.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Thanks...
What you said cheered me up.
